entities.name: Robert Leslie Bellem
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Leslie Bellem was an American pulp magazine writer, best known for his creation of Dan Turner, Hollywood Detective. Before becoming a writer he worked in Los Angeles as a newspaper reporter, radio announcer and film extra.
